body:
Phase 1, server half two. Spec: docs/archive/specs/2026-09-17-expense-lists-design.md.

The list object gains three server-maintained values OUTSIDE `fields`,
following the last_touched_by pattern (never client-written):
  members     [{account_id, email, initials}]
  close_votes [account_id]   — always [] until the phase-2 ticket
  closed_at   null           — always null until the phase-2 ticket

Joining (invite redeem), leaving and account deletion bump the list's
change_seq so the roster reaches every device through ordinary incremental
sync. This is what gives both clients an offline roster with no cache, and
what votes will ride on. Applies to every list kind — shopping lists' last-
touched-by badges benefit too. The members endpoint is unchanged.

Tests: roster in a fresh pull and in a delta after each membership change;
clients cannot write the three values; ordering by joined_at.
title: expenses: server — roster and vote state on the synced list object
